title: Chicken Fajita Bowls
reject_reason: Fajita chicken (bell peppers, onion, chili/cumin) over a grain bowl duplicates live fajita-chicken-rice-bowl / creamy-chicken-fajita-burrito; quinoa vs rice is not a distinct plate, and fajita chicken is a saturated identity per prior rulings.
